title: Concept: Snowflake error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Snowflake SQL compilation error in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the warehouse objects and columns, which is the schema an attacker would target through the reporting endpoint.
applicability: Deployments that render a Snowflake SQL compilation error into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the warehouse objects and columns, which is the schema an attacker would target through the reporting endpoint.
